dialogues.speaker: Arasudraka
dialogues.text: The song that Golden Nara and Aranara sang at Festival Utsava is the brightest, most satisfying song I've ever heard, like the most plump pomegranate.

dialogues.speaker: Arasudraka
dialogues.text: Perhaps this is the melody that is closest to the Sourcesong.

dialogues.speaker: Arasudraka
dialogues.text: I think the longer Golden Nara's journey, the closer the Sourcesong will be.
